I'm profoundly looking for user experience, make things simple, minimal and find a unique approaches to do something new.
summary: Air-Vigor is a minimalist astronaut health monitoring and smart triage software designed specifically for long-duration space missions and confined ISS environments. Long-duration missions expose astronauts to space radiation, isolation, and physiological stress, requiring a streamlined tool that minimizes cognitive load. Air-Vigor features a human-centric interface with a clean central monitoring screen paired with crew wrist-worn biometric trackers to monitor heart rate, sleep, activity, and wrist nerve pulse changes in real-time. It incorporates an interactive "Live Trigger" biological search engine on a right-side vertical tab for instant health assessments. Built with a focus on simplicity over complex engineering, Air-Vigor ensures proactive wellness management and rapid triage for astronauts.
details:
Air-Vigor is a minimalist astronaut health monitoring and smart triage software designed to streamline health tracking for astronauts in confined ISS environments.

What it does & How it works:

- Features a clean central monitoring screen paired with crew wrist-worn biometric trackers to monitor heart rate, sleep, activity, and wrist nerve pulse changes in real-time.

- Incorporates an interactive "Live Trigger" biological search engine on a right-side vertical tab for instant, hassle-free health assessments.

Benefits & Impact:

- Reduces cognitive load on astronauts through a human-centric, minimalist design ("Simplicity is better than complex").

- Enables proactive wellness management, psychological well-being, and rapid triage during long-duration space missions.

Tools & Software Used:

- Designed and prototyped using Apple Keynote and Figma to build an interactive, clickable UI within the 48-hour crunch.

- Emphasizes pragmatic user-centered design tailored for future spaceflight missions.
